description: Application for Prior Approval under Class G, Part 3 of the GPDO for a change of use from office/studio (Class E) to office/residential.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-53b35332-7fff-9a21-dae6-d0874fc85598"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate the site's existing lawful use falls within Class E (Commercial, Business and Service), article 3(6)(n)(betting office) or 3(6)(o)(pay day loan shop). The proposal is considered contrary to the limitations set out in G (a), (c) and (e) of Class G of Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-191f74ea-7fff-fd1a-6dcd-0516b7c0bcbb"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of the proposed unit comprising a hybrid Sui Generis (office and residential) use is considered contrary to the limitations set out in G.1 (c) of Class G of Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-52bcb773-7fff-8e6c-a67e-7fc5dbf9006c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-left: 2pt;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 5.4pt 0pt 5.4pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate the existing use of the floor below the site falls within Class E (Commercial, Business and Service), article 3(6)(n)(betting office) or 3(6)(o)(pay day loan shop). The proposal is considered contrary to the limitations set out in G (a) Class G of Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></p>
